_note: Large model files the product downloads at install time (they are NOT inside the release package). setup/install_parakeet.py reads this file, downloads each file to $RSE_HOME/models and checks its sha256. If a download fails the app keeps working: it falls back to the Whisper speech stage (RSE_TAKES=whisper).

panns_speech.what: audio classifier (PANNs CNN14, speech class) used by the Parakeet take finder to drop breath / chair / noise stretches
